integrity: Theorem follows from renewal resolvent, explicit positive integral, Riccati one-crossing and monotone covariance; numerical checks are corroborative and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Scalar stable additive-noise OU process with one deterministic nonzero reset point, independent constant-rate Poisson resetting; not a statement about spatially distributed, non-Poisson, or state-dependent resets. Preexisting formulas for stationary density and qualitative peak migration are explicitly acknowledged. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Exact modal pinning and saturation in a harmonically confined process with Poisson resetting
